The unpruned transition calculation and flat-law cubic repair did not extend to uniform fitted actual-law and growing-vector moment control; the matched frontier and intermediate information regimes remain open. tldr: The prescribed marginal causal dose-response constancy problem has a proved supplied-density radius \(n^{-4/9}\), a lawful original-record lower envelope \(\max\{n^{-4/9},n^{-4s/(4s+d)}\}\), and an explicit finite-null first-order upper envelope \(\max\{n^{-4/9},n^{-2s/(d+5s/2)}\}\). These match for \(d\le2s\). Supplying the density strictly improves separation order for \(d>5s\); the interval \(2s<d\le5s\) remains unresolved. A concrete pruned cubic calculation repairs the flat-law transition variance on two dose blocks, but uniform fitted-vector cancellation and a growing-dimensional construction remain open. The matched global frontier and exhaustive information comparison are not claimed solved.
